tokens.name: verde-yacare
tokens.usage: Verde Yacaré — the primary brand green (RGB 98 129 81 · CMYK 70 40 80 0). Post grounds, the zigzag footer, frames, the jacaré in the preferred logo. White text on it only at headline size (4.39:1, large text only); never body copy.

tokens.name: verde-medio
tokens.usage: Verde Médio (RGB 81 107 67 · CMYK 70 40 80 25). The 'Yacaré' wordmark ink, the single-colour logo and the green icon set; headline ink on `off-white` (5.29:1). Top band over `verde-profundo` in two-tone posts.

tokens.name: verde-profundo
tokens.usage: Verde Profundo (RGB 31 47 38 · CMYK 80 55 70 70). Dark post grounds and the dark zigzag footer; body text on `off-white` (12.5:1).

tokens.name: terracota
tokens.usage: Terracota (RGB 204 128 82 · CMYK 18 55 70 5). The 'SEGUROS' line of the preferred logo; a small accent only. Fails as text on `off-white` (2.76:1) and on white — keep it to marks and accents there; on `verde-profundo` it reads (4.54:1).

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Off-White (RGB 245 241 238 · CMYK 5 5 7 0). Light post grounds, frames and footers; text on `verde-profundo` and `verde-medio` grounds. The template SVGs export it as #f4f1ee.

tokens.name: branco
tokens.usage: White: negative logo, headline text over photos and on `verde-yacare` / `verde-medio` (5.94:1), the outline frame.

tokens.name: preto-logo
tokens.usage: Ink of the black single-colour logo only (fax, stamps, one-colour print). Not a UI colour.

tokens.name: fundo
tokens.usage: Page / post ground.

tokens.name: fundo-marca
tokens.usage: Brand-colour block on `fundo`: the green half of a split post, frames, the zigzag band.

tokens.name: texto
tokens.usage: Body and supporting text on `fundo` (12.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: texto-marca
tokens.usage: Headlines (`titulo`) on `fundo`: 5.29:1 claro, 12.5:1 escuro.

tokens.name: texto-sobre-marca
tokens.usage: Headlines and taglines on `fundo-marca` and over photos. On `verde-yacare` it is 4.39:1 — headline size (24px+) only.

tokens.name: destaque
tokens.usage: Small accents: a rule, a dot, the meia-lua. Decorative on `off-white` (2.76:1); legible on `verde-profundo` (4.54:1).

styles.name: titulo
styles.sample: E depois de você, quem cuida das finanças?
styles.usage: Post headline: Fraunces Light, set tight (0.9) in 3–4 short ragged lines, left-aligned. Measured from the example posts at 1080px wide.

styles.name: titulo-enfase
styles.usage: The one or two key words inside a `titulo` line: Fraunces Bold Italic, same size and leading.

styles.name: chamada-forte
styles.usage: First line of a tagline lockup beside the logo (Quicksand Bold).

spacing.note: Measured on the 1080×1350 post canvas; scale proportionally for other sizes.

tokens.name: margem-post
tokens.usage: Left text margin of headlines on a post.

tokens.name: moldura-arredondada
tokens.usage: Side inset of the rounded photo frame (templates 3–5; top inset 71px, bottom ~104px where the jacaré rests).

tokens.name: moldura-reta
tokens.usage: Inset of the square photo frame with zigzag base (templates 1–2).

tokens.name: dente-largura
tokens.usage: Period of the zigzag ('dentes') edge: four teeth across a 1080px post.

tokens.name: dente-altura
tokens.usage: Depth of the zigzag edge.

tokens.name: raio-moldura
tokens.usage: Corners of the rounded photo frame (templates 3–5, outline).

tokens.name: raio-reto
tokens.usage: Square frames, split blocks and footers.

tokens.name: raio-meia-lua
tokens.usage: The half-disc 'meia-lua' shape from the brand book, as a graphic accent only (in `destaque` or a brand green); never as a logo or icon container for the jacaré alone.

meta.source: Yacaré SEGUROS_Marca.pdf, Paleta de cores yacare.pdf, post templates (1080×1350) and example posts
